CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS download_grants (
  grant_id text PRIMARY KEY,
  sender_id text NOT NULL,
  artifact_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES resume_artifacts (artifact_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token_hash bytea NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  used_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS download_grants_lookup_idx
  ON download_grants (sender_id, artifact_id, expires_at);

WITH request AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS sender_id,
    $2::text AS artifact_id,
    $3::integer AS ttl_seconds
),
candidate AS (
  SELECT
    request.sender_id,
    request.artifact_id,
    request.ttl_seconds,
    'grant-' || gen_random_uuid()::text AS grant_id,
    encode(gen_random_bytes(32), 'hex') AS raw_token,
    now() + make_interval(secs => request.ttl_seconds) AS requested_expires_at
  FROM request
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM resume_artifacts
    WHERE artifact_id = request.artifact_id
      AND sender_id = request.sender_id
  )
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO download_grants (
    grant_id,
    sender_id,
    artifact_id,
    token_hash,
    expires_at
  )
  SELECT
    candidate.grant_id,
    candidate.sender_id,
    candidate.artifact_id,
    digest(candidate.raw_token, 'sha256'),
    candidate.requested_expires_at
  FROM candidate
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING grant_id, sender_id, artifact_id, expires_at
)
SELECT
  request.sender_id,
  request.artifact_id,
  candidate.grant_id AS requested_grant_id,
  CASE WHEN inserted.grant_id IS NOT NULL THEN candidate.raw_token END AS raw_token,
  request.ttl_seconds,
  candidate.requested_expires_at,
  inserted.grant_id AS persisted_grant_id,
  inserted.expires_at AS persisted_expires_at,
  (inserted.grant_id IS NOT NULL) AS grant_created
FROM request
LEFT JOIN candidate ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN inserted ON TRUE;
